note: The identity-vector contract of change.md 3.1.1: the seven dimensions of change.md 1.1, each an HMAC pseudonym derived by the shared framing below. Both cores (packages/kiwicaptcha-risk and packages/kiwicaptcha-risk-php) assert their compiled derivations against this file in tests/identity_vectors.rs and tests/IdentityVectorsParityTest.php, which serve as the CI check: the repo's manifest lane (tools/ci/protocol-manifest-check.sh) is specific to the execution-v1 opcode register and is not trivially extensible to this shape, so the two reader tests are the enforced surface. The cardinality_bound of a dimension is the number of live pseudonyms one underlying identity can hold at once: ceil(longest ttl / epoch window) for rotated dimensions, 1 for fixed ones. Raw values never leave process memory.

pseudonym.epoch_encoding: 8-byte big-endian unsigned (two's-complement reinterpretation of a negative epoch)

asn.input: client ip resolved to its asn bucket id by the free dataset

granularity.bucket_grammar: a<asn 1..4294967294> | u4/<decimal /16 prefix> | u6/<8 lowercase hex of the /32 prefix>

session.input: 16-byte continuity cookie id (32 lowercase hex chars on the wire)

target.input: pre-auth claimed id, already normalized by the versioned target pipeline

epoch_policy.derivation: epoch slot carries the target pipeline version (currently 1), never a time

agent.input: verified-agent key id from deployment config
